AGENDA  PERSONNEL COMMITTEE  CITY OF ROLLING HILLS
Personnel Committee Meeting  Monday, November 22, 2021  6:30 PM

  All Committee Members will participate in-person wearing masks per Los Angeles County Health
 Department's Health Officer Order effective Saturday, July 17, 2021. The meeting agenda is available
 on the City’s website. The Personnel Committee meeting will be live-streamed on the City’s website.
  Both the agenda and the live-streamed video can be found here: https://www.rolling-
  hills.org/government/agenda/index.php

  Members of the public may submit written comments in real-time by emailing the City Clerk’s office
 at cityclerk@cityofrh.net. Your comments will become part of the official meeting record. You must
 provide your full name, but please do not provide any other personal information that you do not want
  to be published.

  Recordings to City Council meetings can be found here:

   Agenda Item No.: 2.A
  Mtg. Date: 11/22/2021

TO:  HONORABLE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL

FROM:  CONNIE VIRAMONTES , ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT

THRU:  ELAINE JENG P.E., CITY MANAGER

SUBJECT:  DEVELOP RECOMMENDATIONS FOR THE CITY COUNCIL FOR
  PLANNING COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS.

DATE:  November 22, 2021

BACKGROUND:
The Personnel Committee met on Monday, November 8, 2021 and decided to not interview incumbent
Planning Commissioners interested in serving another four year term. The Committee also decided to
conduct interview with resident Nikos Constant on Wednesday, November 10, 2021.

DISCUSSION:
The Personnel Committee conducted the interview with Mr. Constant on November 10, 2021. The
Committee is expected to provide recommendations for the Planning Commission appointments at the
November 22, 2021 City Council meeting.

FISCAL IMPACT:
None.

RECOMMENDATION:
Development recommendations for Planning Commission appointments.
